title: Calibration Protocol for Fluorescence Standard Curve with Fluorescein
author: Richard Tennant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zgkf3uw
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Spin down fluorescein tube
steps.instruction: Spin down the fluorescein kit tube to ensure the pellet is at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Prepare 10× fluorescein stock
steps.instruction: Resuspend fluorescein in 1 mL of 1X PBS to obtain a 10× stock (100 µM). Pipette up and down, examine the solution in the tip for particulates, and continue mixing until the solution is clear.

steps.title: Dilute to 1× fluorescein
steps.instruction: Combine 100 µL of the 10× fluorescein stock with 900 µL of 1X PBS to make a 1 mL 1× fluorescein solution (10 µM).

steps.title: Add PBS to plate columns 2‑12
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL of 1X PBS into wells A2, B2, C2, D2 … A12, B12, C12, D12 (rows A‑D, columns 2‑12).

steps.title: Add fluorescein to column 1
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the 1× fluorescein solution into wells A1, B1, C1, D1.

steps.title: Perform serial dilution across columns
steps.instruction: For each row (A‑D), transfer 100 µL from the preceding well to the next column, mix the receiving well by pipetting up/down three times, and repeat through column 11; discard the final 100 µL from column 11 into liquid waste and do not continue into column 12.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL from well 1 to well 2 (e.g., A1 → A2).
Mix the receiving well (A2) by pipetting up/down 3×.
Transfer 100 µL from the mixed well to the next column (A2 → A3).
Repeat mixing and transfer steps through column 11.
After mixing column 11, transfer the 100 µL to liquid waste; stop before column 12.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence of standards
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the fluorescence instrument and measure the fluorescence of all wells.

steps.title: Record and import data
steps.instruction: Write the fluorescence values in your notebook, then import them into the provided “fluorescein standard curve” tab of the iGEM Data Analysis Template Excel file.
